Thanks for sending over the invoice and the ACH form. Quick questions from our AP team before we can release payment:

1) We operate with a VAT reclaim process for EU-sourced services — can you confirm whether Redwood will require us to provide VAT details on this invoice or if you can reissue VAT-inclusive documentation?
2) Our vendor onboarding requires either a signed W-9 or a UK VAT registration certificate depending on entity. I see a W-9 attached; is that the correct form for Redwood in the US?
3) For ACH setup, can you provide the bank account name exactly as it should appear on the authorization and a contact at Redwood Finance in case we need to confirm micro-deposits?

We expect to process the payment by 2026-09-24 provided vendor setup completes this week. If Redwood can accept a wire sooner, we can accelerate.

Thanks — looping in AP (finance@acmeanalytics.com) for tracking.

Best,
Jordan Mills

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers below and next steps to keep this moving: 

1) VAT/tax: Redwood is a US entity. The attached W-9 is correct for US tax purposes. For EU VAT, we do not currently charge VAT on hosted inference when contracting directly through our US entity; however, we can provide a VAT-exemption statement if your AP needs one for internal reclaim workflows. If you need a reissued invoice with additional VAT fields, we can generate that but will need the billing address and VAT ID you want on file.

2) Bank details: Please use the following exact payee name on the ACH form: "Redwood Inference, Inc." For wires, use the account name and routing shown in section 2 of invoice_2026-07-31.pdf. If you prefer, I can open a DocuSign for the ACH form and that typically speeds vendor setup. Link: https://www.docusign.com/signed/abc-xyz-6789

3) Finance contact: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com) will confirm micro-deposit amounts or wire receipt. I’ve CC'd Laura and Ben (billing) to help with any AP checks.

If you can confirm the expected payment date I will flag finance to release a remittance confirmation as soon as funds hit. Given the timeline you shared, if vendor onboarding completes today our team can accept ACH and expect clearance by 2026-09-24.

Attachments included again: ACH_authorization_form-fillable.pdf; invoice_2026-07-31.pdf; W9_acmeanalytics.pdf
